facts.fact: Cycles shadow catcher with film_transparent and the Shadow Catcher pass OFF: the Combined pass carries the shadow as black with alpha = shadow density; lit floor is alpha 0; the floor's own colour never shows

with view_layer.cycles.use_pass_shadow_catcher ON, the Combined pass no longer carries the shadow (alpha 0 there); the shadow goes to the 'Shadow Catcher' pass as a multiplier (1 = no shadow, lower = shadow), to multiply over the backplate
EEVEE (4.5) has no shadow catcher: an is_shadow_catcher floor renders as a normal opaque floor
the property is Object.is_shadow_catcher (and Object.is_holdout); the matching pass is view_layer.cycles.use_pass_shadow_catcher
